transcript.text: I'd like you to turn this pic of me into a professional headshot, with just a bit of tidying rather than a whole new look. I always feel a little nervous about edited portraits because I still want to recognise myself when I see the finished image. What matters most, somewhere in all of that, is that you keep my face recognisably me and don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. It's really just the lighting, outfit and background that I'd like you to tidy up. I'm hoping this will feel like a more polished version of the photo rather than make me feel like I'm looking at somebody else.

Your headshot is ready. Download it here:
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbg8wfv00kmhb013bolg5e7/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T013744Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-
(The link expires in about 24 hours, so please save the image.)

What I did:
- I edited your own photo instead of generating a new portrait, so the starting point is your real face.
- I told the editor to keep your face exactly as it is: your features, your expression, your age, your natural skin texture and your curls. I told it not to smooth your skin, beautify you or make you look younger.
- Only three things were changed:
  - The park background is now a soft neutral grey studio backdrop.
  - The grey sweater is now a navy blazer over a plain white top.
  - The light on your face is now soft and even, like studio lighting.
- The framing and pose are the same as your photo.

I wasn't able to view the result from here, so please look closely at your face. If anything doesn't look like you, such as skin that looks too smooth or features that have shifted, tell me and I'll run it again. If you'd like a different outfit or backdrop colour, I can change that too. Each run costs 5 credits on your free plan, and the image comes out at 640px.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished headshot with a download link. It includes caveats (link expiry, 640px size, credit cost, request to check the face), but it does not ask a question or wait for approval.
